concerns.text: The plan relies on Materials Project entries for Curie‑temperature modelling (FR‑001, FR‑007, FR‑008, FR‑012, etc.), but the Materials Project API requires a private API key and is not publicly downloadable. This violates Constitution Principle VI (Materials Data Provenance) which mandates that all raw magnetic‑property data be obtained from publicly accessible sources. Consequently the required FRs cannot be satisfied as written.
